question: Discover new, reproducible cases where hp-sim5 behaves incorrectly. For each case: smallest possible reproducer plus quantitative evidence of the failure. Do not fix bugs.

agents.question: Which G-code program-level motion semantics does the browser Upload path (hp-sim-3d/app/workers/moveCommander.js) silently get wrong - relative positioning G91/G90, rapid G0, units G20/G21, arcs G2/G3, dwell G4, modal feedrate, line numbers/checksums, multiple commands per line - compared with the app own reference parser (inspectionToolsController.js parseGcodeText) and with RRF/Klipper defaults? Find the smallest one-file reproducer per divergence and quantify the wrong motion (mm of travel, deposited extrusion, time).

Does the app quality report measure what it claims? Drive hp-sim-3d/app/quality-monitor.js and qualityController.js plus the reference-path overlay (inspectionToolsController.js parseGcodeText) with synthetic deposition paths and reference G-code whose true deviation, rms, percentile, corner count and score are known in closed form. Quantify every disagreement (reported vs exact), including histogram quantile/bin errors, NaN or zero-distance samples, corner-detection thresholds, extrusion accounting, bounds and matched-segment selection. Find the smallest reproducer and state whether the wrong number is shipped and user-visible.

Do the app two shipped playback paths for the same G-code file agree? Use the app own RRF CAN player (integrations/rrf/rrfCanPlayer.js) to decode the compiled plans in public/RRF_CAN_commands/*.can that the preset buttons play, and compare them G-code-move by G-code-move with the Upload path (hp-sim-3d/app/workers/moveCommander.js with the same machine RRF config) for HP4 non-layered as the control, HP4 layered (Q=0.6366197723675814, R=46.6045), and the shipped G6 file public/gcode/tighten.gcode. Quantify any disagreement in motor angles, per-motor line length, effector path and total travel (mm and %), decide whether it is a wrong result in a shipped path or an explained model difference, and produce the smallest reproducer. Beware: the layered catalog-vs-RRF radius difference (0.47-0.85 percent) is already known from 2026-11-17, so report only what that does not explain.
